summary.tldr: Adds pregnancy-related harm as an aggravating factor when courts sentence under the Criminal Code.
what_it_does: Adds a sentencing factor when an offender knowingly assaults a person they know is pregnant.
Adds a sentencing factor when an offence causes physical or emotional harm to a pregnant victim.
Amends section 718.2(a) of the Criminal Code to list these circumstances as aggravating factors.
summary.background: It changes the sentencing rules in the Criminal Code.
